scoring_justification: Checker recomputes crossover ordering, relative margin, ratio, and absolute-value comparisons directly from the agent's raw CSV artifacts — it does NOT read a self-declared conclusion or metric the agent merely typed into a json. The physical findings (drag at low fields, heating at high fields, negligible overshoot effect) are derived fresh in the scorer from the agent's raw velocity table.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference drift velocities for n-type GaAs at T_L=300 K, n_e=3×10¹⁷ cm⁻³, n_i=3×10¹² cm⁻³ (remote impurity scattering) — drawn from the paper's Fig. 12 (steady-state v-F) and Fig. 9 (overshoot peak at 8 kV/cm).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 12 (steady-state velocity-field characteristic for remote-impurity case, 300 K) and Fig. 9 (time-resolved drift velocity at 8 kV/cm showing overshoot peak). The paper reports drag-induced increase up to +20% at fields ≤4 kV/cm, heating-induced decrease up to -10% at fields ≥6 kV/cm, and an overshoot peak of approximately 3.7×10⁷ cm/s that is 'practically identical' between equilibrium and nonequilibrium phonon runs.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values are synthesized to match the paper's qualitative description and quantitative ranges. The crossover from drag to heating is placed between 4 and 6 kV/cm (consistent with the paper's Γ–L transfer threshold at 3–4 kV/cm). Absolute magnitudes are consistent with the paper's Fig. 12 curves for remote impurity scattering. The overshoot peak of 3.7×10⁷ cm/s matches the paper's reported peak and is set equal for both cases (ratio = 1.0).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are grounded in the actual published paper's figures and quantitative claims. The trends (crossover pattern, ~15% enhancement at 2 kV/cm, ~6% reduction at 8 kV/cm, identically 3.7×10⁷ cm/s overshoot peak) are directly from the paper, and absolute magnitudes are traceable to the paper's published curves. The gold embedded here is the SAME data the reference solve.sh writes, ensuring the oracle passes at full reward.

outputs.description: Steady-state drift velocity vs electric field for n-type GaAs at 300 K, with and without nonequilibrium LO-phonon disturbances.
Velocity overshoot peak at 8 kV/cm, showing negligible effect of nonequilibrium phonons.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare the agent's reported velocities to hidden reference values and apply checks for relative trends (drag at low fields, heating at high fields) as well as absolute tolerance. The agent does not need to know the gold values.
